verdict.rationale: Synthesia's API docs describe configuring a webhook to which Synthesia sends a notification when a video completes. The Video API is asynchronous, so you can poll or receive a webhook when a job is ready. This is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback that a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: documentation of event types beyond video completion (e.g. failures, localization/dubbing events), payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: rather than polling Synthesia API, it is possible to configure a webhook to which Synthesia sends a notification when a video completes successfully.
Asynchronous — you submit a job and poll or get a webhook when it's ready.
